descriptions.text: Enchanted hat. The Nemes of Pestilence. This item may only be equipped by a pet. Equipping this item to an eligible pet will imbue the following properties: Eternal Protector of Rage. Pet will become temporarily invulnerable and will gain 2× strength if it is within three meters of its owner and their health is below 10%. Invulnerability will last 60 seconds and can only trigger once per day. Bringer of Death. Bites from this pet have a 75% chance to inflict the Cruel Sepsis debuff.

beats.headline: A hat for Mongo
beats.text: Donut's new class came with accessories for every pet in the party, and the mailbox has delivered hats for Mongo and Rend. Carl asks whether those can be drained too. Donut will not have Mongo's new hat's powers stolen, and Mordecai says they cannot anyway: both are labelled pet accessories. Then the two are on the table. Mongo's is a fabric hat with shiny blue and gold stripes and two wide bands hanging down either side like large, floppy ears: the sort of thing a pharaoh wore, by way of a cheap costume shop. A nemes. Carl examines it. Eternal Protector of Rage, Bringer of Death. It will look absolutely ridiculous on Mongo's head, but that protector benefit is worth it.

beats.headline: Dong does the honours
beats.text: In the garage, while Hedy explains the gremlins who do the bulk of the repairs after a race, Dong Quixote helps Mongo into the hat. Isn't it great, says Donut. The dinosaur looks absolutely ridiculous. Rend starts grunting and bouncing up and down as Donut produces his headband.

beats.headline: Kept on for the parade
beats.text: The float procession takes shape in the garage, and Mongo, Rend, Simoom, Gonk and Bianca are its marching band. Donut's new Gurkha class has brought some pretty wild clothes for all the mercenaries and pets, but for this fight the crew keeps the nemes on Mongo and the headband on Rend. Mongo gets special kukri claw caps for his feet as well, which greatly increase his slicing.
